column2: cor(data_sgr$SGR_2m, data_sgr$mass, use="complete.obs") #weak negative correlation between SGR and mass, let's look at temp-specific trends
#This tells us that correlation is stronger between SGR and mass at 18C than at 23C. Let's see if it is significant:
#this shows a significant mass effect on SGR at 18C, and a near-significant mass effect on SGR at 23C. While the correlation is weak, it could mask our results.
data_sgr$SGR_2m_resid <- resid(lmer(SGR_2m ~ mass*factor(Temp) + (1|ID), data_sgr)) #residuals of SGR are also a good option for more effectively mass-standardizing my growth measurements.
ggplot(data = data_sgr, aes(x = mass, y = SGR_2m_resid, colour = factor(Temp), fill = factor(Temp))) +
